# Poodle Circle

> Free owner guides for the first month with a toy poodle. Not a clinic. No puppy sales.

Poodle Circle (https://poodlecircle.com/) is where a new toy poodle owner picks where they are and opens the page for that week. Instagram (https://www.instagram.com/poodle.circle/) carries a question or a short clip outward. The answers stay on this site.

These are owner routines, not veterinary advice. A puppy who is weak, collapsing, or refusing food should see a veterinarian. Principles: https://poodlecircle.com/#principles

## Where are you now?

- [I haven't brought my puppy home yet](https://poodlecircle.com/30daysguide/#before): Before Day 1.
- [My puppy came home today](https://poodlecircle.com/30daysguide/#day-1): Day 1. One quiet room, a toilet trip, and sleep.
- [We've survived the first week](https://poodlecircle.com/first-30-days/#week-2): Week 2. Alone time for about a minute, then brushing, then the harness indoors.
- [We're figuring each other out](https://poodlecircle.com/first-30-days/#week-3): Week 3 to 4. Apartment barking, teeth, then grooming at home.

## Two ways to read the first month

- [Your first 30 days, week by week](https://poodlecircle.com/first-30-days/): the short path. One page to open each week. Ticks saved on the device.
- [The full toy poodle first 30 days guide](https://poodlecircle.com/30daysguide/): the long version for the night you are in.
- [Free First 30 Days Kit PDF](https://poodlecircle.com/assets/first-30-days-kit.pdf): checklists plus the guide. No email signup.

## This week's question

My toy poodle cries every time I leave the room. What worked for you?

Leave for less time than they can already manage. Toilet first, a safe chew, a calm goodbye, and come back before the noise turns into panic. If the crying gets worse as you stay away longer, shorten the practice and ask a vet or a qualified trainer.

Full answer: https://poodlecircle.com/alone-time/#cries

## Direct answers

- First night: one quiet room where the puppy can hear you, a toilet trip, then sleep. Skip visitors, tricks, and a tour of the house. https://poodlecircle.com/30daysguide/
- House training: out after waking, eating, drinking, playing, and before bed. Praise the finish. Do not punish accidents. https://poodlecircle.com/30daysguide/
- Line brushing: part the coat and comb from the skin out, especially ears, armpits, groin, and behind the legs. If the comb will not pass, stop and book a groomer. Do not cut a mat out with scissors. https://poodlecircle.com/line-brushing/
- Tear stains: once a day, wipe from the inner corner outward with water and dry the fur. No whitening drops. One eye suddenly worse, squinting, or thick discharge belongs with a vet. https://poodlecircle.com/tear-stains/
- Teeth: toothpaste made for dogs, a few teeth, stop while they are calm. Do not use human toothpaste. https://poodlecircle.com/teeth/
- Harness: two fingers of room, chest strap behind the front legs, and a short indoor lift test before the street. Not a collar. https://poodlecircle.com/harness/
- Alone time: start in seconds and minutes. Two hours is a later step for a dog who already settles. A young puppy should not be left for a workday. https://poodlecircle.com/alone-time/
- Apartment barking: reward a quiet second away from the door. Shouting adds noise. Opening the door mid bark teaches them that barking works. https://poodlecircle.com/apartment-barking/
- Night waking after the first month: a last toilet, one calm check, then stop answering the bark. The first night is a different page. https://poodlecircle.com/night-waking/
- Home grooming: comb to the skin between salon visits. If the comb stops, the groomer wins today. https://poodlecircle.com/home-brushing/
- Stairs, cold, and hawks: carry a young toy poodle on a full flight. If you want a coat, they are already colder. In open country, keep a dog this size close and on a lead. https://poodlecircle.com/stairs/

## Not care guides

- The spoiled quiz on the homepage is a named break from puppy homework. The result is a nickname and one next challenge. It is not a diagnosis. https://poodlecircle.com/#game
- Poodle Parkour is a tiny jump game, not a care guide. https://poodlecircle.com/games/poodle-parkour/
